summary: A 23-year-old woman in a party of four fell 100+ ft down a snowfield attempting Ellingwood Point via the South Zapata approach, reporting significant pain in both knees; REACH-29 inserted six AVSAR members, nine more hiked 5.5 mi up South Zapata as backup, a technical lower of ~1,000 ft of scree to the lower basin followed and the subject was airlifted ~21:30; all teams out by 00:55 on 6/22.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue; REACH Air Medical Services (REACH-29); Custer County SAR; Chaffee County SAR-South (CSAR mutual aid)
notes: Parent-opened this run; photo filenames (20200621) confirm the date. Run 651.
